comment: Regularly uses skills that decrease MP, so restore MP to enable use of special attacks on enemy break. Also note that your damage will be curbed if the enemy breaks while they have an effect that increases DEF.

At battle start, the enemy grants an effect that decreases damage taken, and the effect increases at the start of an action.
Be sure to use lots of attacks, as dealing damage can decrease the effect.
The boss uses a barrier, so be cautious as the break gauge is harder to deplete while the barrier is active. Since the max break bonus is high, go for break bonus increases to deal more damage.

This boss's ability applies an effect that reduces damage taken.
The effect decreases in strength as Minions are defeated, and can be fully removed once 2 Minions have fallen.
This boss also uses ATK debuffs and break gauge depletion RES buffs, so be sure to check the Buff/Debuffs status screen and plot your next move carefully.

The boss takes less damage when not in break.
Its also gains extra break gauge depletion RES on odd-numbered turns, and extra DEF on even-numbered turns.
It's best to put it in break on a turn where it doesn't have higher DEF.

The boss has 3 actions, but is reduced to 2 actions when applying an ailment to it.
Also, DMG dealt increases while in break, stacking up to 3 times based on the number of ailments applied.
Try to keep multiple ailments on the boss consistently while timing your attacks for maximum damage.

The boss's ATK and SPD increase each turn.
Its DEF decreases once it reaches the max break bonus, so going for break bonus increases can work to your advantage.

The boss's damage taken increases the more the boss takes damage from follow-up attacks and counterattacks.
Its ATK and SPD increases with each passing turn, and its defense also increases on certain turns.
Try your best to put the boss in break as fast as possible.

DMG taken by the boss increases depending on the number of times allies take critical DMG.
Also, with each time an ally breaks, its break gauge depletion RES decreases.

Breaking a minion significantly delays their action order, so be sure to focus on breaking minions first while racking up critical DMG.

The boss recovers its break gauge by a certain amount each turn and even increases its DEF during certain turns.

DMG taken by the boss will increase depending on the number of times damage is inflicted by basic attacks, skills, and special attacks, in addition to how often the boss breaks, making it easier to inflict even more DMG.
Breaking the boss considerably increases the amount of DMG it takes, so aim to put it in break as much as possible.

The boss and its minions' DMG taken increases when all 3 are hit simultaneously by basic attacks, skills, and special attacks targeting their elemental weakness, making it easier to inflict damage.

However, take note that in longer battles, stacked buffs and debuffs can limit damage.

The boss' DMG taken will increase and break gauge depletion RES will decrease each time ongoing DMG is taken.
This effect can be efficiently increased when multiple types of ongoing DMG are dealt.
So try inflicting as many types of ailments as possible.

The boss's maximum break bonus can reach extremely high levels.
Be sure to increase the break bonus to deal more damage.

The boss also has a skill that inflicts even greater ATK damage as turns pass.
If taking heavy damage, Kioku that recover HP or utilize barriers can help stabilize your party.

The boss unleashes a powerful attack every 2 turns.
The boss's damage can be decreased based on the number of times damage is dealt to 3 enemies simultaneously, targeting elemental weakness.
Prioritize assigning Kioku capable of attacking multiple enemies at once.

The boss's ATK and SPD will also increase with each passing turn.
So be cautious as a prolonged fight will see you take even more damage.

The boss's own ATK and DEF increase upon attacking cursed enemies.
Some Minions will apply curse on certain turns, so try to fully remove this ailment before the boss takes action.

The maximum break bonus for the boss and Minions can also reach high levels.
Be sure to increase the break bonus to deal more damage.

The boss increases DEF based on its own Magic value.
Its Magic decreases each time it takes critical DMG, so include Kioku and Portraits in your party that can increase your critical rate.

The boss's ATK and DEF each slightly increase when it's attacked by an enemy with less than 40% HP remaining.
Make sure to restore HP and use barriers, etc. to keep allies' HP above a certain amount.

Also, the boss's DMG dealt significantly increases when no enemies with a barrier are present, so using Kioku that can apply barriers will be particularly advantageous.

The boss and its minions decrease DMG taken based on their own Magic value.
Their Magic increases with each passing enemy turn, and decreases each time they are attacked targeting their elemental weakness.

Prioritize assigning Kioku capable of attacking multiple enemies at once while targeting their elemental weakness.

The boss decreases DMG taken based on its own Magic value.
Its Magic decreases based on how many of its allies are dealt critical DMG.

Kioku that can deal damage to multiple enemies with a single attack allow you to decrease its Magic efficiently, so prioritize adding them to your party.

The boss's Magic increases when it is attacked, and once Magic reaches max, it delivers a powerful attack.
Note that the boss's Magic increases more when more debuffs are applied to the Kioku that is attacking.

Kioku with a barrier can avoid certain debuffs, so it's best to ensure you have a barrier applied when attacked.

The boss's DEF and SPD increase with each passing turn.
Its damage taken increases once the break bonus reaches 500% or higher, so going for break bonus increases can work to your advantage.

The boss increases DEF based on its own Magic value.
Its Magic increases each time an ally is attacked, but will decrease by a set amount whenever the boss or its Minions break.
Magic continues to increase while in break, so you should aim to deal as much damage as you can in as few attacks as possible.

The boss's DEF increases based on its own charge.
Its charge decreases each time it takes critical DMG, so assign Kioku and portraits, etc. to your party that can increase your critical rate.

At battle start, shield is applied to all enemies.
The enemy's DMG taken and incoming break gauge depletion are greatly decreased while shield is active, so make use of multiattacks and additional DMG to remove the shield.

The boss increases break gauge RES and decreases DMG taken based on its own Magic value.
Its Magic decreases each time a critical hit is dealt to 3 or more allies.

Kioku that can deal damage to multiple enemies with a single attack or increase allies' critical rate allow you to decrease its Magic efficiently, so prioritize adding them to your party.

The boss's Magic increases when it is attacked with a special attack, and once its Magic reaches max, it delivers a powerful attack.
You'll need to time your special attacks carefully.
Its damage taken greatly increases once the break bonus reaches 500% or higher, so going for break bonus increases can work to your advantage.

The boss increases break gauge depletion RES and decreases DMG taken based on its own Magic value.
Its Magic decreases based on how many of its allies are dealt critical DMG.

The boss recovers a certain amount of its Magic each turn, so prioritize adding Kioku that can deal damage to multiple enemies with a single attack or increase critical rate to decrease its Magic efficiently.
